name: Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba PORT HALL / PORT STUDIO
address: Tokyo 105-7501 Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba Office Tower 1F, 1-7-1 Kaigan, Minato-ku
accessSummary: JR Hamamatsucho Station North Exit: 4 min walk / Yurikamome Takeshiba Station, direct deck access: 2 min walk / Toei Daimon Station Exit B2: 5 min walk
hours: Open year-round (except building closure days). The hall and studios can be used 24 hours a day, with extra fees for late night and early morning. Entry is possible from 15 minutes before the reserved time. Inquiries are accepted on weekdays 9:00-18:00

rooms.name: 1F PORT HALL
rooms.note: Island layout is 180 seats (6 per island x 30 islands). Classroom uses 3-person tables. Floor load capacity 700kg/㎡. Includes the foyer and 3 guest rooms. Fees (excl. tax): 1 day (9:00-17:00) 940,000 yen / 4 hours (7:00-22:00) 650,000 yen / extra hour 130,000 yen / late-night extra hour (22:00-7:00) 260,000 yen. For use from April 1, 2027 (applies to new inquiries from October 1, 2026): 980,000 yen / 680,000 yen / 150,000 yen / 300,000 yen

rooms.name: 1F Foyer
rooms.note: Included with hall use. Floor load capacity 500kg/㎡

rooms.name: 1F PORT PLAZA (outdoor)
rooms.note: About 975㎡. Usage hours are in principle 7:00-20:00. Fees (excl. tax): 1 day 300,000 yen / 4 hours 210,000 yen / extra hour 45,000 yen. The user sets up and restores the space to its original condition

rooms.name: 8F PORT STUDIO (AB Studio)
rooms.note: A and B used together. Fees (excl. tax): 1 day (9:00-17:00) 350,000 yen / 4 hours (7:00-22:00) 250,000 yen / extra hour 50,000 yen / late-night extra hour 100,000 yen. For use from April 1, 2027 (applies to new inquiries from October 1, 2026): 365,000 yen / 260,000 yen / 55,000 yen / 110,000 yen

rooms.name: 8F PORT STUDIO (A Studio)
rooms.note: Fees (excl. tax): 1 day 280,000 yen / 4 hours 200,000 yen / extra hour 40,000 yen / late-night extra hour 80,000 yen (no change from April 1, 2027)

rooms.name: 8F PORT STUDIO (B Studio)
rooms.note: Fees (excl. tax): 1 day 130,000 yen / 4 hours 90,000 yen / extra hour 20,000 yen / late-night extra hour 40,000 yen (no change from April 1, 2027)

ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes all time from entry to exit, from setup and preparation through removal of everything the user installed and restoration to original condition. Entry is possible from 15 minutes before the reserved time. The hall and studios can be used 24 hours a day, with extra fees for early morning and late night (late night is 22:00-7:00). Packages can be received and held on the day before the event (cash-on-delivery is not accepted). (Terms of Use, as of May 1, 2026)
ops.loadingHours: The logistics management office is open 7:00-19:00 on weekdays and 7:00-18:00 on Sat, Sun and holidays (for load-in/out outside these hours, call the venue and staff will come to meet you). For the hall, enter via Loading Entrance 2 (blue sign), park in one of the 2 vehicle bays, and bring items directly into the hall through the front door. For the studios, enter via Loading Entrance 1 (green sign) and take Elevator Hi-2 or Hi-3 to the 8th floor. Vehicle limits are height 3.2m or less, length 7.0m or less, width 3.0m or less; consult the venue if larger. Submit the "Temporary Load-in/out Application" at least 7 days before the work date (at least 14 days before for large volumes or heavy items). If there is construction work, also submit construction drawings.
ops.vehicleRules: Two "Temporary Load-in/out Permits" (one for display on the vehicle, one to show at reception), issued after application, are required on the day; without them the loading area cannot be used. Use of the loading area is in principle limited to 30 minutes at 360 yen per 30 minutes, vehicles cannot be left there, and if there is work inside the building, move to the general parking lot on B1F (300 yen per 20 minutes) after load-in/out ends. Heavy items (guideline: 100kg) require protective covering such as blue protective sheeting. For large or heavy load-in/out, building elevator and coordination operator fees may be charged separately. Studio load-in/out uses only the building-designated carts; rental carts are 120 yen per 20 minutes. Parking, bicycle parking and driving outside designated areas are not allowed.
ops.parking: General parking lot on B1F of the Office Tower: about 150 spaces, 7:00-23:00, basic fee 300 yen per 20 minutes, daily maximum 3,300 yen. Mechanical parking (standard cars: height 1,550mm, length 5,300mm, width 1,950mm, weight 2,300kg; HR cars: height 2,100mm, length 5,300mm, width 1,950mm, weight 2,300kg), flat parking (standard/HR cars: length 6,000mm, width 2,500mm).
ops.waitingRooms: Hall use comes with 3 guest rooms free of charge (20㎡, 20㎡, 9㎡; about 8, 8 and 4 people. In the drawing from the October 2021 hall setup notes, Guest Room 3 is 16㎡). There is a smoking area for waiting rooms inside the hall. The studios have Private Room A (20㎡) and B (17㎡), each for about 8 people. (Venue Price List, created September 2026 ver.3 / Studio ver.2)
ops.catering: Catering is arranged centrally by the venue. Partner vendors for reception plans include Folie Classe (total of 200,000 yen or more), CB Service (total of 165,000 yen or more), Grace (food only, 110,000 yen or more) and Dynac, among others. New orders are due 2 weeks before the event and changes 1 week before. Boxed meals and drinks can also be arranged through venue staff, and food and drink service using food trucks is also possible at PORT PLAZA.
ops.restaurants: The commercial zone on floors 1-3 of the same building, "Takeshiba Gurumeriumu" (竹芝グルメリウム), has restaurants, and whether private hire is possible and the number of seats differ by restaurant (examples: on the 2F, Gyoza Sakaba Ryuki (餃子酒場 龍記) allows private hire, 60 seats; on the 2F, Sakanasama (さかなさま) allows private hire, 112 seats; on the 2F, Italian Sakaba HIKAGE (イタリア酒場 HIKAGE) allows private hire, up to 50 seated or 100 standing; on the 3F, CIELITO LINDO BAR AND GRILL allows private hire, 90 seats). Service tickets usable at the restaurants are also issued.
